w:r.w:t: In force for round RND-2314-PENRHOS. This directive settles how an amendment reaches the derived state, in what order two stages that bear on one job apply, and when a cascade stops.

Each lodged amendment is classified by its kind. The seed set is the derived cell or cells named here and nothing else. A cell that is not seeded and is not reached by the cascade keeps the value it holds.
norm cell of the named job
empty; the fields it moves govern nothing
closure cell of the requiring job
closure cell of the requiring job on the row
group cell of the named group
solve cell of the named precinct
solve cell of the precinct of the commitment
rule cell of the named rule
charge cell of every job of that class
the cell its kind would seed
the seed set of the amendment it names

A cell reached by the cascade is computed again. When the value it comes back with carries the digest it already held, the cell is revalidated and the cascade stops there. The cells that stand behind it keep their values and are never visited. When the digest moves, the cells that read this one are reached in turn.

A withdrawal of an edge that leaves the accepted prerequisite list of the requiring job unchanged therefore moves nothing behind that job, and a restatement of an amount whose normalised value is unchanged moves nothing behind the rule.
the cells it is read by
closure, demand and charge of that job, demand of every other job whose closure holds it, group of every group holding it, solve of its precinct
demand of that job, closure of every job that names it as a prerequisite, solve of its precinct
4 ORDER WHERE TWO STAGES BEAR ON ONE JOB

The class multiplier applies to the base charge before any surcharge is added. The surcharges of a precinct are added next. The closure rebate is taken last, on the sum of the scaled charges and the surcharges of that precinct, and never on the scaled charges alone.

Two rows of the edge journal that name the same requiring job and the same required job after the crosswalk is applied are one prerequisite. The second row is rejected as a duplicate and withdrawing either row while the other stands leaves the prerequisite in place.

A job that stands in two open slot groups keeps the group of the lower precedence number, whichever of the two identifiers that group carries, and keeps the group of the lower identifier where the two carry one precedence number. Its membership of the other group is rejected. A group left holding one open member binds nothing at all.
